name: No Other Foundation
overview: The foundation of the church and the believer's life is firmly established in Christ, as Jesus declared He would build His church on the rock of Peter's confession, ensuring its victory over the gates of hell (Matthew 16:18). This foundation calls for a response of faith and obedience, exemplified by the Ethiopian eunuch's desire to be baptized upon encountering the gospel (Acts 8:36). Furthermore, believers are God's workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works that God has prepared for them to walk in, demonstrating that a life built on this foundation is marked by purposeful obedience and spiritual growth (Ephesians 2:10).
